items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: the piano player who played with me, Octave Crosby.

ctx.x: But the guy said she, you see, uh, the, the, matter of fact, the piano player who played with me, Octave Crosby. He said, he said, every night when, when he go uptown. That's right. He said, he said, he said, of course, I mean, she, she, she, she, she done got old. He said, no, Louis Armstrong ain't telling the truth in that book. He said, Mary Jack the Bear's still living. That's right. He said, of course, she done got old. She hangs in the ballroom. Now, but, but all that fight and all that, that's gone out of…
She would remember all those old bands. She'd know.
